value.name: Marylin answers ringing phone
value.description: Marylin picks up the ringing bedroom phone and answers it.
evidence:
In the bedroom, the phone starts ringing. A hand enters to
pick it up.

MARYLIN
Hello?

value.name: Miles warns Marylin to leave
value.description: Miles urgently tells Marylin to leave the house immediately.
evidence:
MILES
Marylin?

MILES
You have to leave the house
immediately!

MILES
No buts. Now. Out.

value.name: Marylin confesses love to Miles
value.description: Marylin apologizes and admits she fell in love with Miles.
evidence:
MARYLIN
Just listen to me. I'm sorry, Miles.
It's true that my initial intention
was to...

MARYLIN
I fell in love Miles.

value.name: Miles reciprocates love
value.description: Miles reveals that he loves Marylin too while still urging her to pack and leave.
evidence:
MILES
So did I. Now pack up a few basics
and --

MARYLIN
You do? You do love me?

value.name: Marylin hangs up on Miles
value.description: After hearing Miles's response, Marylin ends the phone call.
evidence:
MARYLIN
You do? You do love me?

MASSEY MANSION
Marylin hangs up the phone.

value.name: Marylin studies Miles's photograph
value.description: Marylin picks up a framed photo of Miles and looks at it contemplatively.
evidence:
She walks slowly around the room, pausing at the mantelpiece
to pick up a framed picture of Miles, which she
contemplatively regards.

value.name: Marylin discovers Joe hiding
value.description: Marylin notices Joe standing against the wall and is briefly startled.
evidence:
We pan with her walk to bring Joe into frame. He
stands with his back pressed to the wall. She's started for
a moment, but quickly recoups:

value.name: Marylin offers Joe double payment
value.description: Mistaking Joe for someone sent by Mr. Dumbarton, Marylin offers to pay him double to leave.
evidence:
MARYLIN
Whoever sent you, I'll pay double.

JOE
Mr. Dumbarton.

value.name: Marylin shows Miles's picture to Joe
value.description: Marylin shows Joe the framed photo and asks if it is Mr. Dumbarton.
evidence: She shows him the picture of Miles.

MARYLIN
Is this Mr. Dumbarton?

value.name: Joe identifies Miles as lawyer
value.description: Joe corrects Marylin by identifying the man in the photo as Dumbarton's lawyer.
evidence:
JOE
No...

JOE
That's his lawyer.

value.name: Marylin raises offer to triple
value.description: After learning Joe's identity mistake, Marylin increases her payment offer to triple.
evidence:
MARYLIN
Triple!

value.name: Car screeches to a stop outside
value.description: A car abruptly stops outside the mansion, interrupting the exchange.
evidence: We faintly hear a car screeching to a halt.
